empirical_windows_behavior: Translates Direct3D SM1-SM5 shader assembly/IR instructions (dcl_input, dcl_output, dcl_constant_buffer, dcl_resource_texture2d, dcl_sampler, mov, add, mul, mad, dp3, dp4, min, max, sqrt, rsq, sample, ld, ret, and D3D9 0*INF=0 safe multiply lowering) into Metal Shading Language (MSL) vertex/fragment/compute kernels.

On macOS, compiles the generated MSL source directly into a hardware MTLLibrary and MTLFunction on the Apple Silicon / Metal GPU via MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice() and [device newLibraryWithSource:options:error:].
macos_backend_strategy: Generate valid Metal Shading Language (MSL) source and compile via Objective-C Metal.framework (MTLDevice newLibraryWithSource:options:error:).

sources: Apple Metal Shading Language Specification & Metal.framework documentation
